title: Redgap, Rathcoole, Co. Dublin
description:
https://youtube.com/shorts/C3RenW5A7cA

 

 

Ray Cooke Auctioneers proudly present this wonderful luxurious family home to the market with stunning views over the city. This is a fantastic four bedroom four bathroom detached family home situated on a splendid c. 1 acre site. Redgaps boasts c. 258 sq.m of luxurious and light filled living accommodation on an elevated site with stunning picturesque countryside and Dublin City views.

 

The location is next to none as you are mere 5 minutes from Rathcoole Village and all it has to offer with a wide array of local amenities including schools, shops, Avoca and Rathcoole Park along with a host of bus routes, the N7 and M50 road networks and some of Irelands best golf courses.

 

Upon entering this truly spectacular family home from the entrance hallway to the left gives us access to the family room and down stairs bedroom with en-suite, to the right gives access to a large lounge / dining room, stunning open plan kitchen with access to the rear garden, guest wc and utility room. Upstairs offers three double bedrooms, master suite is a fabulous room with ensuite and walk in wardrobe. The upstairs also benefits from an office and large family bathroom.

 

To the front, sides and rear the property is bounded by landscaped green areas, mature trees and the elevated site offers picturesque countryside and city views. The property also benefits from a large double garage. The sunny aspect to the rear offers an abundance of sunlight throughout the day and to the front is an electronic gated entrance with a large driveway. Truly an opportunity not to be missed, call Ray Cooke Auctioneers today.

 

Redgap was built John Watkins Ltd in 2006 using natural stone from Mayo and Donegal and is one of the best properties we will see come to the market in 2025.

 

Viewing is highly advised to appreciate the sheer quality of this magnificent family home, call Ray Cooke Auctioneers today for further information or to arrange viewing.

 

Features
- c. 258 Sq.m
- Luxurious LARGE living accommodation throughout
- BER B1
- Situated on c. 1 acre
- Quaint, peaceful setting
- Full alarm system
- Immaculate condition throughout
- PERFECT FAMILY HOME
- The heating system is a ground source (well) based geothermal system.
- All floors and walls insulated with 200mm insulation board to keep heat in separate zones.
- Each room is thermostatically controlled.
- There is large double garage with gym overhead
- Freshly painted
- Super Views
- Absolutely stunning property
- Viewing highly advised
- M50 and N7 within five minutes' drive
